episode_title: Toronto Panel | The new business of law - new models, entrants and agents of change

real_qa.q: What was the compound annual growth rate of law firm-associated ALSPs from 2015 to 2023?
real_qa.r: Law firm-associated ALSPs grew by 600% between 2015 and 2023, which equates to approximately 28% compounded per year, representing really rapid growth. About 22% of global law firms now have an associated ALSP, and that figure grew by 7% last year.

real_qa.q: What percentage of the global legal services market do ALSPs currently represent?
real_qa.r: ALSPs are currently about $20 billion, which represents approximately 2-3% of the global legal services market. The overall legal services market is growing at about 5% per year, so ALSPs are still very small but represent a very active space.
real_qa.requete: ALSP percentage global legal services market

real_qa.q: Why did BLG create BLG Beyond as a separate ALSP rather than delivering new services through the traditional law firm?
real_qa.r: BLG Beyond was created to operate as an entrepreneurial, forward-thinking entity that could leverage technology and deliver services differently from the start, avoiding the challenge of implementing change within a traditional law firm structure. ALSPs are designed to be agile and can find creative solutions to client problems, something law firms struggle with due to their billing models and risk-averse culture.
real_qa.requete: why BLG Beyond separate ALSP law firm

real_qa.q: What operational advantages does Cleary X gain by operating as a separate entity rather than as a department of Cleary Gottlieb?
real_qa.r: As a separate entity, Cleary X can take capital investment (unavailable to law firms), offer equity to senior leadership employees, operate with remote staff across multiple jurisdictions without unauthorized practice issues, and implement pricing models unrelated to hourly rates. The separate structure also enables greater agility in technology implementation and decision-making compared to the traditional law firm model.
real_qa.requete: Cleary X separate entity advantages law firm

real_qa.q: How has Simplex Legal's remote-first model differentiated it from traditional law firms in the market?
real_qa.r: Simplex Legal operates entirely remotely with no physical office buildings, which allowed it to operate seamlessly during COVID without disruption, whereas traditional law firms were forced to adapt. This model enables lawyers near retirement or already retired to maintain flexible engagement in legal practice, a flexibility that traditional law firms cannot easily replicate.
real_qa.requete: Simplex Legal remote model competitive advantage
